captureNote: Compiled option lists of every shipped story-line card, captured from real behaviour before the legacy two-way choice code was removed. Regenerate only when the shipped content is deliberately changed: run the capture in tests/story-line/options-parity.test.ts and review the diff. Card *names* are deliberately excluded (CG-0MWRSOU91003P36J): the name column is author-editable content prose, so pinning it here turned a plain rename in the story-line editor into a fixture regeneration. The programmatic Gym demo catalogue section was also removed: GymStorylineScene now projects its cards from this same CSV (demoCardsFromCsv), so it would have been a byte-identical duplicate of the `gym` source.
baselineNote: Story-line spike baseline (CG-0MWNHZ51N007STI3): the resource-generalisation and CSV-extension children must leave every captured option list unchanged. A diff is a finding, not a regeneration trigger.
